name: Kelowna
tagline: Lakeside Wine Country in the Heart of British Columbia
description: Kelowna sits on the shores of Okanagan Lake surrounded by vineyards, orchards, and mountains, offering a lifestyle that rivals Napa Valley at a fraction of the cost. Universal healthcare, four-season outdoor recreation from skiing to water sports, and a booming food-and-wine scene make Kelowna increasingly popular with early retirees. Housing has risen but still undercuts Vancouver dramatically.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for Canadian citizens. Others: Super Visa (for parents/grandparents, up to 5 years) or Visitor Record extensions. No dedicated retirement visa — Canada lacks a retiree-specific immigration pathway.
quickFacts.safetyRating: High – safe lakeside community with low violent crime
quickFacts.climate: Semi-arid with hot, dry summers and cold, snowy winters; the sunniest city in BC

housing.description: Studio or older one-bedroom in Rutland or the Highway 97 corridor, away from the lake

dining.description: Mostly home cooking; casual pub meals and low-cost cellar-door tastings

healthcare.description: BC MSP covers essentials; basic dental-vision-prescription supplement

transportation.description: A paid-off older car — Kelowna is car-dependent with thin transit (ICBC insurance + fuel)

entertainment.description: Free lake beaches, hiking Knox Mountain, community events, occasional winery visit

1M.lifestyle: A studio or older one-bedroom in Rutland or along the Highway 97 corridor, away from the lake, keeps housing affordable. A paid-off older car is a near-necessity — Kelowna's transit is thin and the city is built around driving — and most meals are cooked at home. BC's MSP covers the essentials, leaving just a basic dental-and-prescription supplement on the health line. The payoff is the free outdoor life: Okanagan Lake beaches, hiking Knox Mountain, and cellar-door tastings on quiet afternoons. Discipline is required, but the lake-and-mountain setting rewards it.

housing.description: Proper one-bedroom in downtown Kelowna or Pandosy Village

dining.description: Winery lunches and farm-to-table dining a few times a week

transportation.description: A reliable AWD vehicle for winter and ski trips

entertainment.description: Big White ski pass, golf, lake kayaking, wine club

2M.lifestyle: A proper one-bedroom in downtown Kelowna or Pandosy Village, dining out a few times a week across the growing farm-to-table scene, a Big White ski pass, and a reliable AWD vehicle for all seasons. Extended health benefits on top of MSP and a rhythm of summer lake days and winter skiing make for a comfortable, active routine.

housing.description: Nice modern one-bedroom in the Lower Mission or a lake-view newer build

dining.description: Frequent fine dining at winery restaurants like Mission Hill and Quails' Gate

transportation.description: A good SUV, premium insurance, possibly a summer second car

entertainment.description: Premium ski passes, golf-club membership, sailing, wine tours

3M.lifestyle: A modern one-bedroom in the Lower Mission or a lake-view newer build, with fine dining at winery restaurants like Mission Hill and Quails' Gate several times a week. A good SUV handles wine-country drives and Big White ski days, comprehensive private cover layers on top of MSP, and golf, sailing, and wine tours are all within budget. This is a genuinely comfortable Okanagan life with meaningful discretionary margin.

housing.description: Luxury lakeview one-bedroom or junior-two-bedroom in a premium tower

dining.description: Fine dining as routine plus exclusive winemaker dinners

healthcare.description: MSP plus executive-health and premium private supplements

transportation.description: A luxury SUV plus flights from YLW

entertainment.description: Exclusive golf and yacht-club access, heli-skiing, private wine tours

domesticHelp.description: Weekly housekeeping plus seasonal yard and snow service

luxuryExtras.description: A boat slip on Okanagan Lake, quarterly travel, ski chalet access

5M.lifestyle: A luxury lakeview one-bedroom or junior-two-bedroom in a premium tower, frequent winemaker dinners, a nice car, and a weekly housekeeper. Golf and wine-club memberships, a boat slip on Okanagan Lake, and premium private cover put this firmly into upscale resort living, with a large margin over the local cost of living.

housing.description: Prime lakefront luxury apartment or penthouse at the top of the market

dining.description: Near-daily fine dining and catered harvest events

healthcare.description: MSP plus concierge-grade and international medical cover

transportation.description: Multiple luxury vehicles and chartered flights

domesticHelp.description: Full domestic help — housekeeper plus errands and property support

luxuryExtras.description: A boat, multiple properties, first-class travel, arts patronage

10M.lifestyle: A prime lakefront luxury apartment or penthouse, near-daily fine dining, a luxury vehicle, and a boat on Okanagan Lake define the top of Kelowna's market. Full domestic help, concierge-grade private cover, exclusive golf-and-wine-club access, and a large travel budget fill it out. Kelowna is a small resort city, so the scale of local dining and luxury services is limited — this tier tends to fund a beautiful lakefront home base plus frequent travel rather than big-city extravagance.
